description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractBuzzVideoURL within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the BuzzVideoURL module. The class serves as a base for handling video URLs, providing a constructor, a getter for the URL, and an abstract method to obtain an embedded URL. It also uses traits and exceptions indicating its role in URL processing and validation.
